name: A Friend of the Family
summary: Menethil Harbor fears its relics will fall to local enemies. The harbor authorities send the Menethil Statuette to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep for safekeeping.

sections.title: A Precarious Harbor
sections.body: Menethil Harbor links the northern Eastern Kingdoms to the south. The port honors the late King Terenas Menethil II of Lordaeron, but treacherous marshes and enemies surround it. With threats mounting, harbor leaders fear the exposed outpost cannot protect relics from the fallen northern kingdom.

sections.title: The Dragonmaw Threat
sections.body: Dragonmaw orcs still infest the Wetlands. The clan has a dark past and a taste for ruthless advantage. Harbor defenders fear the orcs would pillage the Menethil Statuette for conquest, then defile it or turn it to their own ends.

sections.title: Straight to the Highlord
sections.body: The courier carries the relic straight to Stormwind Keep, bypassing the usual military and bureaucratic channels. There it goes to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon, regent to the young King Anduin Wrynn. The capital's leaders are trusted to safeguard a piece of Lordaeron's heritage.

faq.answer: The Menethil Statuette is a valuable heirloom tied to Lordaeron's royal line and King Terenas Menethil II. Its history links the northern kingdom with the Alliance, making it a target for scavengers and enemies.

faq.q: Why can't the statuette stay in Menethil Harbor?
faq.answer: Menethil Harbor is isolated among hostile swamps, dark iron dwarves, murlocs, and orcs. Its garrison fears the settlement cannot protect such a meaningful relic.

faq.q: Who are the Dragonmaw and why do they want it?
faq.answer: The Dragonmaw are orcs entrenched in the Wetlands. Harbor officials fear they would plunder prestigious Alliance relics, even at the cost of their warriors, and desecrate or misuse them.

faq.q: Why deliver the relic directly to Bolvar Fordragon?
faq.answer: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon is Stormwind's regent and protector of young King Anduin. Giving him the relic directly bypasses administrative delays and places it in the capital's strongest hands.

faq.q: Where is Highlord Bolvar Fordragon located?
faq.answer: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon is in the throne room of Stormwind Keep, beside the boy-king Anduin Wrynn.

faq.q: How does Menethil Harbor connect to King Terenas?
aliases: why is it called menethil harbor
faq.answer: Menethil Harbor honors King Terenas Menethil II, who led Lordaeron and supported the Alliance of Lordaeron during the Second War. He died during the Third War.

angles.text: As a human, protecting an heirloom of the Menethil dynasty preserves Lordaeron's proud, tragic memory and affirms Stormwind's duty as the last great human kingdom.
As an Alliance member, delivering the relic honors the historic northern Alliance and keeps its symbol from the Dragonmaw.
As a paladin, you may see the Menethil name as a reminder of the founding patron of the Knights of the Silver Hand. Protecting the relic is a solemn duty for a holy warrior.
